The `_combine_regex` is used for a group of patterns. The string pattern `(?P<str>...)` is part of this group.

In my reproduction script:
`text = Text(f"'{url}'")` where `url = "https://user:pass@example.com"`.
So `text` is `'https://user:pass@example.com'`.

The string regex `r"(?<![\\\w])(?P<str>b?'''.*?(?<!\\)'''|b?'.*?(?<!\\)'|b?\"\"\".*?(?<!\\)\"\"\"|b?\".*?(?<!\\)\")"` will match the whole thing as a string.

If the string is matched as a string, then the URL inside it will not be matched by the URL regex because `RegexHighlighter` (or rather `text.highlight_regex`) probably does not highlight inside already highlighted spans?
